credit: Blackboard architectures (Erman, Hayes-Roth, Lesser, Reddy, Hearsay-II, 1980; Nii, 1986) and multi-agent debate (Du, Li, Torralba, Tenenbaum, Mordatch, 2023); design by Fable (DESIGN-live-collab-fable.md, 2026-11-25); replay pattern of tail_replay.py and reserve_replay.py.

protocol_constants.board_prompt: collab.BOARD_PROMPT; the division-of-work rule only in arms with division_of_work true (owner decision 2026-11-26)
protocol_constants.evidence: arithmetic: the judge reason (none if the judge thinking was cut); coding: pass count and exactly one failing public case (owner decision 2026-11-26)

concurrency: <= 20 requests per node by default (--per-node, hard cap 25); one permit per agent for its life; an agent has one request in flight at a time (its gate calls included)
judge: run_variants.judge_with_reason, unchanged (main tree, read-only); the exact verifier and hidden cases only score, after the agent's last model call

D'.note: plain continuation, the worker logic: thinking to 30,720, forced answer within 32,768

C'div.note: protocol + division-of-work rule (owner decision 2: a separate arm)

cohort_rule:
recorded cases of the default-type arms swarm-generic-hard18-v1-roll12cancel (G),
swarm-relay-hard19-v1-roll12cancel (G), swarm-wide-hard20-v1-roll12cancel and -roll12wide, swarm-aot-hard21-v1-p-roll12wide
(P) in which all four first-wave agents (slots 0-3) finished their plan request with more than CUT (8,192) tokens, none
was cancelled and none was accepted. Per puzzle (corpus, task) the case with the lowest seed (ties: the arm listed
first) is 'primary' (41 cases); every other cohort case is 'extension' (the grey-zone rerun: 81 pooled cases). Every
planned stream is checked here: plan stage request_end present, token ids consistent with usage, still thinking at the
cut (no Inkling content-text token, id INKLING_CONTENT_TEXT from inkling/shim.py, in the first CUT ids), variant
xl_forced_original, no extra prompt text.

gate_all_of: wrong(C) == 0 over all attempts (an accepted answer the exact verifier rejects is wrong)
novelty(C) >= novelty(D') - 0.02 (share of a segment's word 5-grams absent from every text another agent of the case wrote before the segment started; mean over post-cut thinking segments)
decision_rule.applies_to: each protocol arm C in {C', C'div} separately against D'; the idea continues if any protocol arm passes (two protocol arms: the chance pass rate is up to about twice the single-arm 8 %)
decision_rule.grey_zone: C ahead by 2 or 3 rescued puzzles with rules 1, 3 and 4 met: run the extension cohort (40 cases, collab_replay.py --cohort extension) and pass if C rescues at least 6 more puzzles than D' on the pooled 81 cases, a puzzle counting as rescued by an arm if any of its cases is rescued; rules 1, 3, 4 again on the pooled cases
decision_rule.stop: anything else ends the idea; the rejection goes to review (lab rule)
decision_rule.incomplete: any job with an infrastructure fault, a missing job, a prompt or prefix mismatch, or an embedded plan that differs from the plan file: no decision (rerun the incomplete jobs with --jobs and pass both output directories to the report)

pairing: arms share prefixes, agent seeds (1000 * seed + 27100 + slot), judge seed bases and nodes ((job index + slot) % 4); same-seed requests do not reproduce on this serving, so the arms are independent samples per case
cost: worst case 41 x 4 x 22.5K x 3 arms = 11.1M generated tokens; about 1.8 fleet hours
